facts.fact: Le Matin reports Morocco's DGSSI is developing AI tools to improve threat detection and analysis and speed incident handling.
Le Matin reports Morocco's DGSSI is developing AI tools for threat detection and has begun creating a laboratory devoted to these technologies.
Le Matin says DGSSI launched maturity studies of banking, transport and energy under Morocco's national cybersecurity strategy to 2030.
DGSSI published a 'critical' alert on Thursday 12 November 2026 about attacks on ConnectWise ScreenConnect users.
Minister Loudyi said a DGSSI study of critical-importance infrastructures found compliance with national requirements above average, with individual reports sent to each institution.
DGSSI's watch centre recorded 1,070 security alerts, 81 high-risk, and flagged 2,154 threats to administrations, public bodies and critical infrastructures, in 2026.

facts.fact: Le Matin reports the National Defence Administration is working on a revision of Morocco's existing cybersecurity law to adapt it to sector developments.
